categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
